capabilities: : Move unfinished tasks between daily notes
: Automatically roll over tasks upon daily note opening
: Send selected tasks to tomorrow's note
: Collect tasks from the past week
intentEvidence: Move unfinished tasks between daily notes without copying and pasting.
problem: Manually tracking and transferring unfinished tasks between different daily notes is time-consuming and prone to error.

relations.evidence: Rollover Plus is based on Rollover Daily Todos by Lukas Mölschl

summary: A task management plugin that moves unfinished tasks between daily notes, allowing for automatic rollover or manual selection-based movement.
